status_note: Cue sheet by S11; nothing generated. The runner generates only the three one_off_cues (one take each, D-011) into this folder and logs credits in sound/manifest.jsonl; every other cue is a series library file from content/series1/sound/, plus one reused s1b01 one-off file.
sources: content/series1/episodes/s1b02/script.en.json (same beats b1-b9 and line ids l01-l29; sfx_notes identical except the quoted words in b2 and b8)
timebase: Anchored to beat and line ids, not seconds: no storyboard or measured takes exist yet. Offsets are against the script's silent_seconds; S13 places every point effect against the measured voice and the edited shot lengths (D-014 rule 6, D-0M2). Both language cuts use the same cues and the same anchors; only the line timings differ.

reused_episode_cues.use: b4 under l17, final creak slice only
reused_episode_cues.why: Same wooden chair by the almirah; reused instead of a new cue (D-011 reuse). If s1b01's file is missing or unusable, drop the placement.

one_off_cues.prompt: A steel saucepan of milk heating on a gas flame in a small kitchen, heard faintly from a floor above through an open stairwell: the low steady hiss of a gas burner, a faint metallic tick of the pan, the milk slowly coming up to the boil with soft bubbling and a rising froth at the end. Distant, muffled, quiet night, no voices, no music.
one_off_cues.why_not_library: Listed by the library as an s1b02 one-off (b3); no kitchen sound elsewhere in the series.

one_off_cues.prompt: A man drinking from a steel tumbler, two quiet human swallows of warm milk, close and soft, in a silent room at night. No breathing, no voice, no gulping, no music.
one_off_cues.why_not_library: The library assigns b4's swallows to 'voice take / episode cue sheet'; s1b02/voice/takes.hi.json and takes.en.json have no swallow take (checked by grep), and the whisper shot must carry no voice or breath a transcript could catch, so it is made as an effect, not a voice take.

one_off_cues.prompt: A dry cotton cloth slowly wiping the inside and outside of a steel tumbler, soft rhythmic rubbing strokes on thin steel with a faint metallic ring, a few metres away in a quiet small room at night. Unhurried, steady, no clinks, no voices, no music.
one_off_cues.why_not_library: Library lists it as an s1b02 b9 one-off with sfx_steel_glass_tray as an alternative; that file is a lift-scrape and a clink, not a sustained cloth wipe for ~5 s, so the slice is kept only as the fallback.

placements.anchor: episode start, continuous with s1b01 b11's bedroom room tone (same file, same level); runs under every bedroom beat b1, b3-b9
placements.duck: -6 dB under every line; deeper dips in b4 (whisper/drinking), b6 (Chhoti), b7 (l27) and b9: see mix.ducking
placements.note: No ceiling fan. From b6 head the crickets come down 4-6 dB (pre-dawn state 3): high-shelf cut ~-4 dB above 3 kHz on the same file, as the library notes; no new bed.

placements.anchor: ~0.2 s into the 1.2 s opening silence, shot 1 insert, as Mausi's fingers leave the folds
~0.5 s into the opening silence, with the hand withdrawing
~0.9 s into the opening silence (she settles on the bed's edge); must end before l01
placements.note: Soft settle, not a jangle. If the silence is shortened in the edit (D-0M2), keep the crinkle and the bangles and drop this.

placements.anchor: in the gap after l03, before l04
placements.note: One far dog. Never under a word.

placements.anchor: b2 head to b2 end, hard cut in and out with the picture
placements.note: Concrete landing with the bare-bulb hum. amb_bedroom_night continues beneath at about -36 dB, low-passed ~2 kHz (the door is pulled almost to). Short hard concrete reverb on l05-l08 is a mix setting.

placements.anchor: in the 0.8 s silence before l05, then once more in the gap between l06 and l07
placements.slice: two or three ticks of the key on its ring per placement
placements.note: Billu's signature prop. Stops before l08: the key and the toothpick go still on 'बारह'. No sound for the toothpick stopping.

placements.anchor: right after l08 ends, to the cut back to the bedroom
placements.note: Down the narrow flight, going away; let the last steps carry ~0.5 s over the b3 head at -30 dB, low-passed (heard from the bedroom).

placements.anchor: in the 0.6 s silence before l09 or the gap after l10
placements.note: Second and last dog of the episode.

placements.anchor: starts in the gap after l10, peaks between l11 and l12, gone before l13
placements.note: Placed once, very low, a far highway wash under the bedroom bed. Not under any protected line (l05-l08, l17, l26, l27).

placements.anchor: from b3 head (with the drone entering) to b3 end
placements.filter: far below through floor and stairwell: low-pass ~1.5 kHz, a little stairwell reverb
placements.note: Billu at the kitchen gas downstairs. Fades up slowly; the boil rises only in the last second, then out on the cut to b4.

placements.anchor: starts a few frames before l14 and runs under it
placements.slice: the two dry paper taps and a soft fingertip stir only; NOT the powder hiss
placements.note: Library note: nothing else from the tray. Nothing falls; the hiss part of the file must not be used here (s1b03 l11: only kesar in the milk).

placements.anchor: under l17, with shot 3 (the boys' hands tightening)
placements.slice: the final wooden-joint creak only (~0.5 s), no scrape
placements.note: Same chair by the almirah as s1b01 b9. Place in the gap after 'पी लो।' so it never sits on a word of l17 (protected). The cloth part of 'cloth and creak' is left to the creak; no cloth cue is made for it.

placements.anchor: shot 5, the drinking (~1.8 s after the whisper shot)
placements.note: Two quiet swallows, ~0.6 s apart. Under the dipped bed, no music. Nothing in shot 4 (the whisper): no voice, no breath.

placements.anchor: ~0.3 s into the 2.2 s silence before, shot 1 (the empty glass on the tray)
placements.slice: the set-down clink only; no lift scrape

placements.anchor: shot 2, ~1.2 s into the silence, as he is laid down
placements.note: Must finish before l18.

placements.anchor: in the comma gap of l18, between 'शाबाश,' and 'मेरी बच्ची।' (en: the matching gap)
placements.note: Once, as she strokes Kiran's hair. If the measured take has no usable gap, move it into the 0.1-0.2 s just before l18.

placements.anchor: first ring lands on the b5 shot 4 fist insert, right after l18's last word; the ring runs across the cut into b6 and stops on the b6 shot 1 insert (she answers)
placements.slice: one ring plus the start of the second, cut dead when she answers
placements.note: Signature phone sound, generic, no song.

placements.anchor: one single isolated call under l26 (in the gap after 'तू मेरी बेटी है।'), then a very thin layer to b7 end
placements.slice: one isolated call for the first placement
placements.note: 'A first bird outside the grille'. Out under l27 with the bed.

placements.anchor: shots 1-3 (~0 to ~5.2 s into the 6.0 s beat), stops dead before shot 4
placements.filter: off screen, a few metres away to the right: slight room reverb, low-pass ~6 kHz
placements.note: Billu wiping the glass at the tray, heard only. Slow, unhurried strokes.

placements.anchor: shot 2 (over Mausi's shoulder), one early bird
enters at b3 head, under Mausi's l09; holds very low under all of b3 and b4 l14-l17; OUT completely at the last word of l17
placements.trim: discard first ~4 s (fade-in); 2 s crossfade loop
placements.out: 0.5 s fade out on the end of l17, so the whisper shot (b4 shot 4) and the drinking (shot 5) have no music
placements.note: Two calm people. Nothing in b1 and b2.

placements.anchor: under l26 'तू मेरी बेटी है' (en: the matching sentence); ducks out under l27
placements.slice: one single warm, slightly detuned harmonium-like held note (~3-5 s) taken from the file, not the melody
placements.out: 1.0 s fade out starting on the first word of l27
placements.note: Plants the finale's motif (library note). If no clean held note can be cut from the file, drop this placement rather than use a phrase of melody; do not make a new cue.

placements.anchor: shot 1, on the fist opening (the two crisp folds)
placements.note: One low note. Cut hard at the end of shot 1 or let it sit under mus_rise_thin; never ring past shot 3.

placements.anchor: shot 3, on the eye open a slit; continues into shot 4 (eye shut)
placements.out: cut dead with the picture at the cut to black
placements.note: Thin rising tone. Ends on silence, not a resolve.

placements.anchor: after the cut to black, following one beat (~0.8 s) of total silence
placements.note: Short end sting; the episode's last sound. Then end.

in_out: b1, b2: no music (room, paper, bulb). s1b01 ended with music cut dead on l28, so the episode opens on the bed alone.
mus_bed_drone in at b3 head, very low through b3 and b4 l14-l17; fully out at the end of l17. The whisper and drinking shots have no music.
b5, b6: no music. Nothing under Chhoti's call.
b7: one held harmonium-like note (slice of mus_ending_lullaby) under l26, ducking out over the first words of l27. Nothing under l28.
b8: no music; room tone only under l29.
b9: mus_swell_reveal on the fist opening, mus_rise_thin on the eye, cut to black on silence, ~0.8 s of total silence, then mus_sting_cut. End.
music.glimpse: Any glimpse cut from this episode uses this sheet over its own range and cuts bed and music dead with the picture. No glimpse-only sound (library reuse_rules).

ducking: Ambience beds duck 6 dB under every line; the drone ducks 8 dB.
l08 (protected, 'बारह' / 'Twelve'): landing bed and bedroom spill duck 10 dB, nothing else under it; the key ticks stop before it.
b4 shot 4 (the unheard whisper, ~2.2 s) and shot 5 (drinking, ~1.8 s): bedroom bed dips a further 8 dB (about -38) and holds flat; no effect in shot 4, only the swallows in shot 5.
l19, l20 (Chhoti on speaker): bed ducks 8 dB, no music, no effect under them.
l27 (protected): bed ducks right down (12 dB) so every word is clear; the harmonium note is gone by its second word.
l26 (protected): bed ducks 6 dB; the note and the single bird sit in the gap after the first sentence, never on a word.
b8: 1.0 s silence before l29 is room tone only (no key sound); nothing under l29 but room tone.
b9: bed at about -36 (near silence) under the cloth, bird and stings; at the cut to black everything cuts dead with the picture, then ~0.8 s of digital silence before the sting.
Point effects never sit on a word; when a measured take moves, the effect moves to the nearest gap.
voice_processing: l19, l20 (Chhoti, Mausi's phone held flat on speaker in the bedroom): band-pass ~300-3400 Hz, light saturation, light colour (speaker in the room), every consonant survives, fully voiced (library mix.phone_voice_fx).
l05-l08 (landing): short hard concrete reverb, low send (mix setting, not a cue).

All bedroom lines: dry. From b4 the door is open: a low landing spill (amb_stairwell_landing at about -36 dB, low-passed) may sit under the bedroom bed if S13 finds the open door reads too dead; optional.
mix.perspective: Bedroom-side perspective for everything off screen (sneakers going away, milk below, Billu's cloth in b9): low-passed and quieter.
mix.no_fan: No ceiling fan in any part of this mix (script sfx_notes; library mix.no_fan_rule).
mix.levels_note: level_db values are starting points relative to full scale before the -14 LUFS master; S13 sets final levels against dialogue.

fallback: If a one-off fails or comes back unusable after its one take (plan 7.8): milk boil -> drop (b3 then has bed, dog, truck and drone); swallows -> drop (the shot plays on the dipped bed; never use a voice breath); cloth wipe -> slow-scrape slice of sfx_steel_glass_tray at -28 dB, repeated twice with gaps. If music fails: raise the bedroom bed 3 dB in b3-b4; for b9 keep the cut to black on silence and end without a sting.

credit_estimate.basis: 17 credits per eleven_text_to_sound_v3 generation, one take (proof manifests, library credit_estimate). Library and reused cues cost nothing here.
